name: Breathwork
intro: Welcome. Your breath is the one thing you always have.
It's your anchor. Your reset button. Your bridge between mind and body.
Right now, we're going to use it intentionally.
Find a comfortable position. Hands on your belly if that feels right.
We'll start simple. Just follow my voice.
body: Let's begin with a four-count breath.
Breathe in through your nose. Two. Three. Four.
Hold gently. Two. Three. Four.
Exhale through your mouth. Two. Three. Four.
Hold empty. Two. Three. Four.
Again. In. Two. Three. Four.
Hold. Two. Three. Four.
Out. Two. Three. Four.
Hold. Two. Three. Four.
Good. You're doing beautifully.
Now let's extend the exhale. This activates your calm.
Breathe in for four. Two. Three. Four.
And out for six. Two. Three. Four. Five. Six.
In for four. Two. Three. Four.
Out for six. Two. Three. Four. Five. Six.
The longer exhale tells your nervous system: you are safe.
Feel your heart rate begin to slow.
Now let's try a cleansing breath.
Inhale deeply through your nose. As deep as you can.
Hold it at the top. Feel the fullness.
Now exhale hard through your mouth. Let it all go. Everything.
Again. Deep inhale. Fill every corner of your lungs.
Hold. And release. A big, audible exhale.
One more. Breathe in all the calm you need.
And breathe out everything you don't.
Let's settle into a natural rhythm now.
No counting. No structure. Just your body breathing itself.
Notice the cool air entering your nostrils.
Notice the warm air leaving.
That's the cycle of life. In and out. Give and receive.
You are part of this rhythm. You always have been.
For these final breaths, imagine you're breathing in light.
A warm golden light that fills your chest.
And as you exhale, imagine releasing anything dark or heavy.
Light in. Weight out.
Light in. Doubt out.
Light in. Fear out.
You are lighter now. You are clearer now.
closing: Let your breathing return to its own natural pace.
You don't need to control it anymore. It knows what to do.
Notice how different you feel from when you started.
Your breath did that. It's always available to you.
Open your eyes when you're ready. You carry this calm with you.
